elements.element: Customer has no minimum purchase or volume commitment.
elements.evidence: Section 2.1 expressly requires Customer to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 during the current twelve-month term.

elements.element: Customer pays only for usage or ordered Services.
elements.evidence: The true-up requires payment of any difference between the reduced commitment and Fees for Services ordered, so Customer may pay for amounts beyond ordered Services.

elements.element: The commitment is limited to the current 12-month term.
elements.evidence: Section 2.1 limits the commitment to the current twelve-month term and states that no commitment applies to a subsequent term absent a new written agreement.

elements.element: Customer may reduce the commitment on 30 days' notice.
elements.evidence: Customer may reduce or terminate the commitment on 30 days' written notice.

elements.element: Any shortfall is handled through a true-up rather than a penalty.
elements.evidence: Customer's sole shortfall obligation is a true-up equal to the difference between the reduced commitment and Fees for Services ordered; penalties, liquidated damages, and accelerated Fees are expressly excluded.
